messages:
Ravi: throwing a pattern on the board: 'evidence_envelope' — a compact signed blob adapters emit for any non-trivial fallback decision. Goal: deterministic repro, cheap to ship (base64), and useful for billing/audit without forcing full telemetry.

Zoe: love the name. can you sketch fields? we need to avoid adding a new telemetry channel though. envelope must be optional and small.

Ravi: sketch (conceptual):
```json
{"env_v":"1","manifest_epoch":"2026-03-22T12:34:00Z","decision":"local->dedicated","reason_code":"KV_UNAVAILABLE","cost_delta_ms":"12","billing_tag":"bt:123","nonce":"rN8a...","sig":"hmac:..."}
```
(all of the above encoded and base64'd to keep headers compact)

Hector: Ops notes: we should limit size to ~256 bytes and require envelope only when fallback actually happened. For privacy, redact request-level identifiers unless tenant opts in.

Mina: runtime implication: SDKs should expose an optional 'fallbackEnvelope' on errors so apps can surface useful messages to end-users or attach to their own logs. But by default we don't surface raw HMACs to users.

Zoe: billing: include a 'billing_tag' (short) so downstream billing pipelines can attribute tokens to the original request model/variant. This avoids double-charging during switch. Also helpful for cost-analysis.

Ravi: security: sig must be per-tenant KMS-backed HMAC key or per-region secret. Envelopes are short-lived (TTL 30s). Controlplane can verify if tenant key is present; otherwise accept unsigned but mark "unverified_env" in UI.

Hector: UI: shows "fallback occurred" row with a tiny decoded envelope: decision, reason_code, cost_delta_ms, billing_tag. If unverified, show amber triangle. Also provide a link to raw envelope for support.

Mina: policy: manifest should add a single opt-in flag: envelope_policy = none|summary|full. none means no envelopes; summary means envelope only for aggregated events; full means envelope for each fallback. default summary for dedicated, none for hardware_isolated.

Zoe: for private installs with no egress, adapters can still emit envelopes locally and make them retrievable via admin APIs. Controlplane shows only an "envelope_unavailable" marker. Keep behavior explicit so customers know what data leaves their network.

Ravi: error mapping: if runtime refuses a fallback because manifest forbids it, return 409 + code ERR_FALLBACK_FORBIDDEN and include a tiny envelope with reason_code and manifest_epoch (no sig). SDK surfaces typed FallBackDenied with 'manifestEpoch' field.

Hector: add 'fallback_ticket_id' field (uuid) to envelope so controlplane, adapter logs, and billing can join events. keep it short like 8-12 char base62 token.

Mina: testing: add a 'dry_envelope' mode for canaries where controlplane simulates envelope generation without affecting traffic. useful for validating cost_delta logic. opt-in per tenant.

Zoe: retention: stored envelopes should be kept N days (configurable) and we should document TTL for HMAC keys so verification can be replay-protected.

Ravi: I'll draft a one-page RFC addendum describing: envelope format (compact), policy flag, SDK surface, error codes, ticketing, and UI expectations. Ping @Mina for SDK examples.

ops-bot: pinned to #architecture. Tagging @Hector for ops checklist (envelope size limits + retention).
